name: libro-full
audience: Libro power users and partners who want the full Libro-eligible skill surface. The operator is expected to be comfortable with the full Brain architecture, session rituals, and dispatch.
_note: libro-full extends libro-core with the dispatch trinity (advisor-mode, council-mode, orchestrator-mode). Additional skills (dashboard-view, brain-hygiene, cross-dept-decisions, dept-activation, content-pipeline, marketing-orchestrator, scroll-stop-prompter, govcon-workflow, cerebro-agency-pipeline, decision-scaffold, mobile-planning-capture) are deferred to a later release — they land here only after passing the externalization pre-commit hook.
